concerns.text: The plan claims that 8 000 inference calls (500 trajectories × 8 models × 2 conditions) each ≤ 45 s will stay within a 6‑hour CI wall‑clock budget when parallelized across two GitHub‑provided CPUs (≈ 2 threads per model). Even with perfect 2‑thread parallelism this would require ~50 hours of wall‑clock time (8 000 × 45 s ÷ 2 ≈ 180 000 s ≈ 50 h), far exceeding the stated budget. This makes the compute feasibility claim unrealistic under the low‑resource constraints of the Constitution (VI).
